body: Add a comment to the `system:habitat_registry_finalize` stage in `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs` (around line 376-382) explaining WHY a second refresh is needed: `update_daily_filter_clogging` modifies `filter_state.clogging_index`, which `compute_filter_media` reads (habitat.rs:164) to compute FilterMedia oxygen exposure. Without this comment, the dual-refresh pattern looks redundant and a future contributor may remove it, silently introducing stale clogging data in the serialized registry.
